info.name: Civicon — Auth, Issues & Media
info.description:
Auth, identity and civic issue reporting for the Civicon backend.

Start the API with `npm run start:dev` and seed it with `npm run seed` — every seeded account uses the password in {{demo_password}}.

Folders run top to bottom: later requests reuse tokens and ids that earlier ones set.

variable.description: Shared by every account created by `npm run seed`.
Set automatically by any sign-in request.
Used to prove the 401 messages are identical.
Set by 'Sign in as a second citizen'.
Set by 'Attach a photo' or the media listing.

item.name: Auth
item.description:
Sign-up and sign-in. Both register and login return { token, user }; the token's claims carry the user's roles, so guards need no database round-trip.

Login and register write `token` and `user_id` into the collection variables, so every later request is authenticated automatically.

request.description:
Registration always creates a CITIZEN. There is no `roles` field to send — volunteering is an action a citizen takes, not a role they hold, and AGENCY / SPONSOR / ADMIN come from the seed or an admin grant.

The email carries a random suffix so the collection can be re-run: the seed already owns the fixed addresses, and a duplicate returns 409.

item.name: Users (admin only)
item.description:
User administration, restricted to ADMIN. There is no POST /users — registration is the only account-creation path, since a second one would produce users with no password.

This folder is self-contained: it signs in as the seeded admin, creates a disposable user to operate on, and deletes it at the end. Safe to run end-to-end.
